name: simpleaccounts-uae
description: Open-source accounting software for UAE businesses with VAT compliance, invoicing, payroll, and financial reporting
author: SimpleAccounts <support@simpleaccounts.com>

scripts.frontend:build: cd apps/frontend && rm -rf node_modules && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && CI=false npm run build
scripts.backend:build: cd apps/backend && ( [ -f ./mvnw ] && ./mvnw clean package || mvn clean package )
scripts.test:frontend:e2e:auth: cd apps/frontend && npx playwright test auth-flow-complete.spec.ts auth-screens-complete.spec.ts auth-comprehensive.spec.ts
scripts.test:frontend:e2e:registration: cd apps/frontend && npx playwright test registration-complete.spec.ts
scripts.test:frontend:e2e:reset-password: cd apps/frontend && npx playwright test reset-password-complete.spec.ts
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.validate:frontend: cd apps/frontend && npm exec eslint -- --ext .js,.jsx src/ && npm test -- --run
scripts.fix: npm run format && cd apps/frontend && npm exec eslint -- --ext .js,.jsx src/ --fix
